beats.summary: Samuel intercepts the name Jasmine Winsong and learns the Funky Cat is a jazz club.

evidence.snippet: Samuel: I'm intercepting a name. Jasmine Winsong. She works for Goldenface.
Michael: Not who, what. The Funky Cat is the hippest Jazz Club in town.

beats.summary: Goldenface holds hostages and threatens to blow up the stadium with a bomb hidden in a puck.

evidence.snippet: Goldenface: Ha! This is gonna show them that I mean business.

beats.summary: Michael confronts Goldenface, who shoots at him and his ally [STAGE] jumps in front to take the bullet.

evidence.snippet: Goldenface (dodges the puck and shoots at Michael):
[STAGE] jumps in front of Michael to receive the bullet

beats.summary: Michael reflects on his personal struggles and loss of self-confidence.

evidence.snippet: Michael: Where had I gone wrong? All I wanted was to start a family with my beautiful wife.
Narrator: It wasn't easy for Scarn to admit that he had lost his self-confidence.

beats.summary: Michael performs 'The Scarn' dance in a bar to cheer himself up with friends and bachelorettes.

evidence.snippet: Michael (A funky beat sounds from the Jukebox and Michael starts dancing poorly): Well my name's Michael Scarn and I'm here to say, I'm about to do The Scarn in a major way.
Todd Packer (as a drunken man in the bar): If doing The Scarn is gay, then I'm the biggest queer on Earth!

notable_quotes.quote: It'll take a lot more than a bullet to the brain, lungs, heart, back, and balls to kill Michael Scarn.
notable_quotes.speaker: Michael
